newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says no firm 1997 forecast.
newsitem.headline: ING says no firm 1997 forecast.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday it would not give a firm profit forecast for the current year in view of its forthcoming listing on the New York Stock Exchange.

"(ING) achieved good earnings growth in the first three months of 1997. However, in view of the share placement on the occasion of the listing on the New York Stock Exchange... the management board has decided against the announcement of a firm profit outlook for full-year 1997 at this time," ING said in a statement.
ING is due to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange from June 13, 1997.
